RESEARCH OPPORTUNITY

Postdoctoral scholar

Lead laboratory and outdoor pilot experiments investigating nitrogen transformation and removal in treatment systems.

All opportunitiesSPRING 2027

Your role

  • Experimental design, system operation, and water quality monitoring.
  • Data analysis, manuscript and proposal preparation.
  • Student mentoring.

Required qualifications

  • Ph.D. in Environmental Engineering, Environmental Science, Soil and Water Sciences, Biogeochemistry, or a closely related field.
  • Experience in nitrogen cycling, organic matter dynamics, or water treatment processes.
  • Strong laboratory, experimental design, quantitative analysis, and scientific writing skills.
  • A valid U.S. driver’s license, ability to drive, and willingness to travel frequently to the study site.

Preferred experience

  • Nutrient analyses for soil and water samples.
  • Column, mesocosm, or pilot-scale treatment experiments.
  • Hydraulics, flow control, residence time, and treatment performance evaluation.
  • Analytical instrument operation, troubleshooting, and laboratory QA/QC.
  • Statistical analysis using R, Python, or similar software.

HOW TO APPLY

Let’s hear from you.

Email Dr. Jing Hu with the subject line Postdoctoral Application and include:

  • Cover letter describing relevant experience and research interests.
  • Curriculum vitae (CV).
  • Two representative first-author publications.
  • Contact information for three references.
Email your applicationjing.hu@ucf.edu
